title.l2: Follow so you don’t miss it

lines.text: One A.M. A gas station on Highway nine. The only light for forty miles.
Leo had one rule on the night shift. Lock the door after midnight.
At one sixteen, a car pulled up to pump six.
Which was strange. There is no pump six.
I need gas. And I need to come inside.
Sorry, we're closed. You can pay at the pump.
Leo checked the security camera. The car was there. But the driver's seat was empty.
And the man knocking on the glass didn't show up on camera at all.
